[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Codex adapter conformance for handoff commands[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]codex-handoff-guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]codex-handoff-guard: count only the final answer in the Codex [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]turn-integrity signal, classify SASE handoff commands, replace the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]silent pass with a bounded continuation that re-drives a stranded [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]handoff, state Codex's real exec-yield ceiling in a single-turn [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]directive, and clarify the monitor and final skill wording.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make in-agent sase monitor start fast and never silent[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]fast-monitor-start[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]fast-monitor-start: resolve a pinned caller without a full project scan,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]do one lane-scoped monitor read per start (adding an index filter in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-core if needed), add start timing, and print a stderr line before [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]any slow work.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Host records and surfaces a killed handoff[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]aborted-handoff-evidence[dim] · [dim][/dim]after fast-monitor-start[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]aborted-handoff-evidence: write an in-flight marker from in-agent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]handoff commands, have the runner adopt a late handoff or record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]handoff_aborted, write accurate recovery evidence, and notify the user [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]when a handoff was killed.[/#D7D7AF]
